exceptions.reason: MobSF 0.4.5 reads only the source manifest and defaults a missing uses-sdk target to 26. Gradle sets targetSdk = 37 for all app variants, confirmed in the merged debug manifest, so this rule's targetSdk < 29 precondition is false. This does not establish OS patch status or protection on older unpatched Android versions supported by minSdk 26.
findingSelectors: Activity exported, targetSdk<29 and launchMode != singleInstance or taskAffinity is not empty
